title: Publish current ADPL app draft to Live (frontend release checklist)

requirements.summary: Promote the latest draft build to Live without introducing any functional changes, ensuring the live URL loads and the login screen is reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: The Live version matches the latest draft version at the time this request is executed.
No additional code changes/features are introduced as part of publishing.
After publishing, the live URL loads the app successfully and the login screen is reachable.

file_operations.description: Add an English-only, non-functional release checklist documenting the steps to promote the current draft build to Live, including a smoke-test verifying the app loads and the existing login screen is reachable at the live URL (no UI/behavior changes).
